name: AnnotatedRegion
desc: There is a generic type, which is only used in app_bar and nav_bar in the source code to change the state variables and navigation bar styles. The generic type is usually SystemUiOverlayStyle.

fields.name: value
fields.desc: A value which can be retrieved using [Layer.find].

fields.name: sized
fields.desc: If false, the layer pushed into the tree will not be provided with a size.

nodes.name: AnnotatedRegion Changes State Variables and Styles
